repos_data.description: Zotero MCP server: search, citations, add by DOI, safe writes, semantic search and PDF page images for Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP client. TypeScript, local-first.
MCP server for Scholar Sidekick — resolve any scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS, WHO IRIS) into 10,000+ CSL styles or nine export formats, single or batch.
